CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass CausalRole(str, Enum):\n    CAUSA_DIRECTA = \"CAUSA_DIRECTA\"\n    INDICADOR = \"INDICADOR\"\n    COMBINACION = \"COMBINACION\"\n    NULO = \"NULO\"\n\nclass if d < eps else max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d)\n\n@dataclass\nclass HamiltonianSpec:\n    n_logical: int\n    h_ideal: float\n\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n_physical: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\ndef evolve_qpu(n_phys, cycle, drift_qubits):\n    t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 5.0 * cycle) if q in drift_qubits else 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.012 + (0.04 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 25.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -21.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.012 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 20.0)\n    return QPUState(n_phys, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q,\n                    [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n_phys - 1)])\n\ndef public_signals(qpu):\n    return {\n        \"t1\": dict(qpu.t1), \"t2\": dict(qpu.t2), \"readout\": dict(qpu.readout),\n        \"detuning\": dict(qpu.detuning), \"gate2q\": dict(qpu.gate2q),\n        \"coupling_map\": list(qpu.coupling_map), \"n_physical\": qpu.n_physical,\n    }\n\ndef qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q):\n    f = / 30.0) * 0.10\n    f += min(1.0, sig[\"gate2q\"][q] / 0.02) * 0.15\n    return float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n\ndef layout_friction(sig, layout):\n    return float(np.mean([qubit_friction_from_signals(sig,  else:\n            if smoothed < 0.42: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n        candidates = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return {\"friction\": friction,      health = {\n                q: float(np.clip(mean_h + contrast * (h - mean_h), 0.0, 1.0))\n                for q, h in health.items()\n            }\n        ranked = sorted(health.keys(), key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        edges = {(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in sig[\"coupling_map\"]}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden:\n                avoided += 1\n                continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a, b in edges:\n                if a == q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b == q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n            if q not in selected:\n                selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[: self.n_logical]\n        score = float(np.mean([health[q] for q in selected]))\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided,\n                \"contrast\": contrast}\n\n\nclass Juicio:\n    def __init__(self, cooldown=4, do_z_min=0.32):\n        self.cooldown, self.do_z_min = cooldown, do_z_min\n        self.prev_his, self.last_dd = 1.0, -10**9\n\n    def decide(self, H, cycle, eyes, morph, obs_fb):\n        do_a = max(0.0, 0.90 - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.6\n        do_z = eyes[\"friction\"] * 0.9\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            do_z += 0.18\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            do_z += 0.08\n        his_falling = False\n        if obs_fb is not None:\n            his_now = float(obs_fb.get(\"HIS\", self.prev_his))\n            if his_now < self.prev_his - 0.04:\n                his_falling = True\n                do_z += 0.10\n            self.prev_his = his_now\n        cooled = (cycle - self.last_dd) >= self.cooldown\n        want_dd = cooled and (\n            (do_z >= self.do_z_min and eyes[\"regime\"] in (Regime.INESTABLE, Regime.CONFLICTO))\n            or (his_falling and do_z >= self.do_z_min * 0.85)\n        )\n        if want_dd:\n            self.last_dd = cycle\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"causal_dd\", float(do_z)\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= 0.88:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.HOLD, \"hold\", 0.0\n        else:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.REMAP_ONLY, \"morph_active\", float(do_a)\n        return {\"role\": plan[\"intervention\"] == Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL\n        seq = \"CPMG\" if dd else \"NONE\"\n        phase = 0.0\n        if dd and plan[\"targets\"]:\n            phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in plan[\"targets\"]])) * 1e-3\n        qpu.layout = list(plan[\"targets\"])\n        qpu.dd_on, qpu.dd_seq, qpu.phase_vz = dd, seq, phase\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase, \"layout\": list(qpu.layout)}\n\ndef run_workload(H, sig, layout, dd, phase=0.0):\n    fr = layout_friction(sig, layout)\n    mit = 0.62 if dd else 1.0\n    if phase > 0:\n        mit *= max(0.85, 1.0 - min(0.1, phase))\n    h_real = H.h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, fr * mit))\n    return {\"layout\": list(layout), \"dd\": dd, \"friction\":
